acceptance_checks.current_desktop_platform: Electron desktop app in apps/stage-tamagotchi, packaged for macOS, Windows, and Linux; Tauri is historical/outside the current checkout.
runtime_boundaries_identified: Electron main process and Injeca composition root
Renderer windows with per-window Eventa contexts
Embedded Electron plugin host with manifest/session/module/capability ownership
Sandboxed plugin iframe and message transport
Main-owned HTTP, MCP, and Godot lifecycle managers
Shared plugin protocol and SDK wire boundary

documentation_drift.claim: Multi-transport support is deferred because repository design marks it Planned.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: packages/plugin-sdk/src/plugin-host/runtimes/node/index.ts implements in-memory transport and throws for websocket, worker, and Electron transports.

documentation_drift.claim: Full capability orchestration is deferred because it remains Proposed.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: Current SDK exposes partial capability/dependency APIs but not the proposed full waiting-deps state machine.

documentation_drift.claim: External and remote plugin modes are future architecture rather than current runtime behavior.
documentation_drift.documentation_evidence: packages/plugin-sdk/docs/design/architecture.md describes embedded, external, and remote host modes as active design intent.
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: The desktop host currently constructs ExtensionHost with runtime electron, while external Node transports are incomplete.

rationale: The answer is evidence-backed, distinguishes current Electron implementation from historical Tauri and design intent, compares viable options, and provides reversible migration and concrete verification criteria. The named evolve-software-architecture skill was unavailable, so the evaluation used the repository and supplied rubric directly.
